takes.note: A is the bait: she stands at the mouth of the press corridor, closer to the Anvil than anyone else will be.
B walks past the sleeping Anvil and stands on the arming plate; it wakes, goes for A and is pressed. Then she wakes the west amp.
C stands on the roaster's plate.
D stands at the back of the roost so the wasps have to cross the fire to keep their distance, steps out of the way of what they already shot, and wakes the east amp.

notes: Objective complete at beat 8.02: Wake both amps.
Survivors: Tape A, Tape B, Tape C, Tape D.
